title: What Ten-Thousand-Year Governance Is
definition: Ten-Thousand-Year Governance: governance thinking in ten millennia.
description:
Ten-Thousand-Year Governance is governance thinking in ten millennia. It sits squarely in Future Governance & Society, the frontier where deep-time councils science becomes governance logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are succession-scale. Societies that master governance hulls early will shape message design practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why deep-time councils programs worldwide now treat Ten-Thousand-Year Governance as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Ten-Thousand-Year Governance needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Readiness Estimator: Ten-Thousand-Year Governance
definition: Estimates Ten-Thousand-Year Governance readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Ten-Thousand-Year Governance components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a governance hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Ten-Thousand-Year Governance Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Ten-Thousand-Year Governance: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Ten-Thousand-Year Governance — governance thinking in ten millennia.

Phase 1 — Prove (deep-time councils): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (governance logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (message design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (succession): governance hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and civilization-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
